name: The Collector
summary: An intercepted dispatch from gnoll raiders in Elwynn Forest lays out when gold shipments leave the abandoned mines. It is addressed to a figure called 'The Collector' and points to an organized operation near Stormwind's garrison.

sections.title: A Paper Trail in the Paws of Gnolls
sections.body: Riverpaw gnoll packs in western Elwynn Forest carry more than furs and crude weapons. Among them, a parchment called the Gold Pickup Schedule lays out dates and times for gold taken from local mines. The intercepted note directs each shipment to an overseer identified only as 'The Collector.'

sections.title: Unsettling News for Goldshire
sections.body: Marshal Dughan hears the news at the Lion's Pride Inn and learns that gold is still being mined and moved. Official mines across Elwynn have been closed for months because of gnoll attacks, kobold infestations, and roaming bandits. Gnolls carrying shipping schedules point to an organized criminal network stealing the kingdom's wealth.

sections.title: Eyes on the Brackwell Patch
sections.body: The schedule places the suspected Collector near the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch in eastern Elwynn Forest. Marshal Dughan has heard whispers of the name, but has no clear proof of who leads the ring or where the gold goes. The dispatch gives the garrison its first solid lead in the hunt for whoever directs the shipments.

faq.q: What is the Gold Pickup Schedule?
faq.answer: The Gold Pickup Schedule is an intercepted note carried by gnolls in Elwynn Forest. It lists dates and times for mined gold to be handed over to a figure called 'The Collector.'
'The Collector' is a criminal figure believed to be near the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch in eastern Elwynn Forest, coordinating an illicit gold trade.

faq.q: Why is Marshal Dughan shocked by the schedule?
faq.answer: Marshal Dughan is shocked because gold is still being mined and shipped despite the official mines being closed for months. Gnoll attacks, kobold infestations, and roaming bandits forced the closures, so the schedule reveals a hidden operation stealing from the crown.

faq.q: Why do gnolls have this note?
faq.answer: The Riverpaw gnolls of western Elwynn appear to carry the schedule as couriers, guards, or collaborators in the gold smuggling, bearing orders for the pickups.

faq.q: Where does this investigation lead next?
faq.answer: Giving the schedule to Marshal Dughan leads to Manhunt, which sends you to find and eliminate the Collector near the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch.

faq.q: Where is the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch located?
faq.answer: The Brackwell Pumpkin Patch lies in eastern Elwynn Forest, north of the river and east of the Maclure and Stonefield vineyards.

angles.text: Every ounce of gold smuggled from Elwynn denies the Crown tax revenue and raw materials while the kingdom struggles to protect its borders.
As a rogue, you can read the intercepted schedule and trace contraband through the criminal networks in Elwynn's wilderness.
As a miner, you know Elwynn's shuttered mines still hold copper and precious metals. Someone is working those veins unlawfully while honest miners stay home in fear.
